answer: Each identity anchors to one city taxi medallion, checked against the city registry: number and the umber cab must match one owner; the city caps supply, so none can be printed on demand. One medallion backing two identities is revoked. Each fake costs one medallion at about 5,000 units, comet hologram verified at transfer, plus a cab, insurance and a 30-day wait; 100 fakes cost 500,000 units and 100 cabs. No paperwork shortcut: each cab passes its own meter test, and a lantern-lit inspection cross-checks every plate against the registry, so bulk forgery collapses at the first audit.
